description: Edit one pick's title, curator note, URL or author. The note is the curator's own words and is never rewritten by AI, so preserve their voice.

author.description: Author or creator as the person gives it (books, articles, posts), e.g. from "Title - Author - why". Stored as the pick's author and never replaced by added details. Keep it out of the note. Pass an empty string to remove it.

itemId.description: Item id from list_items or search_items.

note.description: New curator note. Pass an empty string to clear it.

url.description: New URL. Pass an empty string to clear it.

name: update_item
title: Edit a pick
